name: Wrong Velocity
description: Not traveling with the expected velocity

name: Too Dim
description: Object is dimmer than the detection threshold

name: Strange Location
description: Near/in a suspicious location like a detector defect or edge

name: Ambiguous
description: Hard to tell what's going on here

name: Artifact
description: Visual artifact, like a bad pixel column

name: Bad Analysis
description: Something has compromised this analysis, invalidating the objects

name: Bad MPC
description: This MPC was determined to be a false positive, another object, or otherwise invalid

name: Bad Dataset
description: Something has compromised this dataset, invalidating the objects

name: Bad
description: Something is wrong with this object that is not encapsulated by other flags.
